title: Ignored idea to carry the Space Shuttle on a 747

tellings.quote: ideas and bad ideas In 1972 when they were first planning the space shuttle,

plain: A former NASA doctor named Greg Rogers, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, recalls that in 1972, when NASA, the US space agency, was first planning the Space Shuttle, some ideas were good and some were bad. He tells of an idea to carry the Shuttle on the back of a Boeing 747 jumbo jet that was at first ignored, as an example of how good ideas can be passed over inside large organizations.
